title: BLAST searches using orthologr
text: blast() function provides easiest way perform BLAST search. can see, hit table shows output BLAST+ search. blast() function runs blastp default BLAST+ algorithm. Different BLAST+ algorithms can selected specifying blast_algorithm argument, e.g. blast_algorithm = "tblastn". See ?blast details. blast() function returns 21 columns: query_id, subject_id, perc_identity, num_ident_matches, alig_length, mismatches, gap_openings, n_gaps, pos_match, ppos, q_start, q_end, q_len, qcov, qcovhsp, s_start, s_end, s_len, evalue, bit_score, score_raw. Since blast() stores hit table returned BLAST data.table object, can access column, using data.table notation. case need specify PATH BLAST+ please use path argument: blast() function also allows pass additional parameters BLAST+ search using blast_params argument. following example, remote BLAST+ search performed. cases default e-value BLAST+ searches 1E-5 default blast_algorithm blastp. Since BLAST+ searches can computationally expensive, possible specify comp_cores argument working multicore machine. query_file subject_file arguments specify path corresponding fasta files storing CDS files, amino acid files, genome files query organism subject organism interest. Make sure using CDSfiles, amino acid files, genome files corresponding argument seq_type must adapted according input data format. Use : CDS files -> seq_type = "cds" amino acid files -> seq_type = "protein" genome files -> seq_type = "dna" format argument specifies input file format, e.g. “fasta” “gbk”. blast_algorithm argument specifies BLAST program (algorithm) shall used perform BLAST searches, e.g. “blastp”,“blastn”,“tblastn”,etc. , eval argument defines default e-value shall chosen best hit threshold.

text: Divergence Strata obtained categorizing dNdS values deciles. decilation range dNdS values important. dnds.threshold defines upper level cut dNdS values. title: Comparative Genomics with R
text: First, users can retrieve coding sequences entire genomes using biomartr package (see details ). Users can find corresponding map https://github.com/drostlab/dNdS_database. way, users can compute dN/dS values pairwise genome comparison.
code: install.packages("biomartr") library(biomartr) # download all coding sequences for Mus musculus Mmusculus_file <- biomartr::getCDS(organism = "Mus musculus", path = getwd()) # download all coding sequences for Homo sapiens Hsapiens_file <- biomartr::getCDS(organism = "Homo sapiens", path = getwd()) # compute dN/dS values for Homo sapiens versus Mus musculus Hs_vs_Mm_dNdS <-    dNdS(query_file      = Hsapiens_file,        subject_file    = Mmusculus_file,        delete_corrupt_cds = FALSE,        ortho_detection = "RBH",         aa_aln_type     = "pairwise",        aa_aln_tool     = "NW",         codon_aln_tool  = "pal2nal",         dnds_est.method = "Comeron",         comp_cores      = 1 ) # store result in Excel readable csv file install.packages("readr") readr::write_excel_csv(Hs_vs_Mm_dNdS, "Hs_vs_Mm_dNdS.csv")

title: Perform Divergence Stratigraphy — divergence_stratigraphy
text: Introduced Quint et al., 2012 extended Drost et al. 2015, divergence stratigraphy  process quantifying selection pressure (terms amino acid sequence divergence) acting  orthologous genes closely related species. resulting sequence divergence map (short divergence map),  stores divergence stratum first column query_id inferred orthologous genes second column. Following steps performed obtain standard divergence map based divergence_stratigraphy: Divergence Stratigraphy:  1) Orthology Inference using DIAMOND BLAST reciprocal best hit ("RBH") based blastp 2) Pairwise global amino acid alignments orthologous genes using Needleman-Wunsch algorithm 3) Codon alignments orthologous genes using PAL2NAL 4) dNdS estimation using Comeron's method (1995) 5) Assigning dNdS values divergence strata (deciles)

Options : "cds", "protein", "dna". case "cds", sequences translated protein sequences, case "dna", CDS prediction performed corresponding sequences subsequently translated protein sequences. Default seq_type = "protein". outgroup_file currently unused; reserved future use. eval numeric value specifying E-Value cutoff hit detection. format character string specifying file format sequence file, e.g. "fasta". Default "fasta". ortho_detection character string specifying orthology inference method use. Default ortho_detection = "DIAMOND_RBH" (DIAMOND2 reciprocal best hit). Available methods: "DIAMOND_RBH": DIAMOND2 reciprocal best hit (default; fast, recommended) "DIAMOND_BH": DIAMOND2 best hit "RBH": BLAST reciprocal best hit "BH": BLAST best hit "Orthofinder2": OrthoFinder2 (currently development) sensitivity_mode character string specifying DIAMOND2 sensitivity level. used ortho_detection "DIAMOND_RBH" "DIAMOND_BH". Options: "faster", "fast" (default), "mid-sensitive", "sensitive", "-sensitive", "-sensitive", "ultra-sensitive". max.target.seqs numeric value specifying number aligned sequences keep (DIAMOND2 ). Default 10000. delete_corrupt_cds logical value indicating whether sequences corrupt base triplets removed input file. Default FALSE. cdd.path currently unused; reserved future use. path character string specifying path orthology inference tool executable. add_params character string specifying additional parameters passed orthology inference tool. DIAMOND2 methods, use diamond_params instead. Default NULL. diamond_params character string specifying additional parameters passed DIAMOND2. used ortho_detection "DIAMOND_RBH" "DIAMOND_BH". Default NULL. comp_cores numeric value specifying number cores used multicore computations. quiet logical value specifying whether successful interface call shall printed . clean_folders boolean value specifying whether internal folders storing output used programs shall removed.
